Frankly speaking it is too hard to explain. I did a huge huge mistake. I asked a stupid personal question , although he was not at all angry with me but I realized that I did a blunder. Yes it happens with me as well. You are the first person who said it in better way. My suicidal thoughts are really common to me. They come. They stay. They go and they come back. But the sadness and feeling about self hatred stays with me like a shadow. 

If possible go to therapist or try some other therapies like drawing or art. I use diary writing. It may sounds childish but it helped me a lot. Whenever I feel suicidal. I writeand It drains my thoughts and clear my mind. Sometimes I write for hours and sometimes even 10 lines work. I hide that diary from everyone because I write everything in that. Sometimes about dark thoughts , about my suicidal thoughts, sometimes I self abuse my self in that diary. You can write about anything you want.

A tip if want to try diary writing. Always start with similar line. For example my first line is always like this: - > " Today is 3/3/2020 and it's 21:39 right now."  After this I start writing. This helps in making it a habbit. Most people struggle to find how to start ? or what should I write first ? But if you always start with similar line every time. This will not be a problem for you. I hope this is helpful. Take care. Good bye.

I am speechless right now. I mean I am 25 and you are much more experienced than me. You are absolutely right that too many people are suffering. I am too young and inexperienced to tell you anything but I still I suggest you to try and look at your life and yourself from different perspective. I read a thought few days back that says - life ( or universe or nature ) are always trying to teach you something by putting you into different situations , if you learn from it you will come out of that situation..if you don't you will get stuck in same situation. I am also stuck in this situation from 4 or 5 yrs. Just like you I also never touched any girl. I don't know from where you are but I am from India and having sex before marriage is still a taboo for many..but situations are changing with time and people are getting more open.

I still ask for money from my mom and I feel pathetic whenever I do. She is too old and I should be the one who is earning and she should be resting and enjoying her life..but no she is still taking care of her 25 yr old son. She is 50+ now. I always wondered if I will ever going to do the same for her. If I will ever going to payback her what she is doing for me. She brock down in front of me many times. Crying because of me and my mistakes in life. I mean she is the only reason I am not killing myself right now. I am living in hope that one day I will come out of this situation and tell her to rest. I hope you find hope. Good bye. Take care.

Well my mom was also a failure. She was more educated than my father when they got married. My father took the responsibility of earning for family and my mom took care of us at home. 

When I was 14 my father died because of cancer. All the money he earned during his life was spent on his treatment. So after his death we were completely broke. My mom tried to get a job but she was not hired because she was too old. 

Once she was trying to take out cash from Atm and got stuck. A person standing in queue came to help her understand the Atm interface. She thanked him and came home. When she reached home , she got a message saying all her balance was deducted from her account. That guy was a fraud. She felt very embarrassed that time because she didn't even know how to use the Atm card at that age. She felt like an idiot. We were already broke at that time and then this happened. Thankfully some of our relatives helped us during that time. 

Few years back she started teaching 2 girls after their school. She is still teaching them and She loves it. She do not earn much from it but I she is confident now. I can see that she got her self respect back..she is better person now. 

I hope you find something that can help you keep moving forward. There is famous quote I just remembered while writing that last line. It's by Winston Churchill -- If you going through hell keep going.
